name: How long does a bathroom shower installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom shower installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most bathroom shower installations take between 2 to 5 days, depending on the scope of work. Replacing a prefabricated shower stall in an existing footprint can often wrap up in 2 to 3 days. A custom tiled walk-in shower takes closer to a full week due to proper waterproofing, mud bed curing, tile laying, and grout drying times. If your project involves relocating plumbing lines, updating valves behind the wall, or repairing hidden moisture damage on the subfloor, the timeline can extend further. We outline a clear day-by-day schedule before starting work.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard replacement takes 2 to 3 days, while a custom tiled shower usually takes 4 to 7 days to allow for proper waterproofing, tiling, and curing.
